# Additional review tasks

Drop additional task files into this directory as `NN-task-name.md`
(for example `10-check-epg-links.md`). Every `.md` file here except this
README is appended to the main review prompt in filename order.

Each task file should contain:

```markdown
### Task: <short name>

<What to check, what counts as a finding, and whether auto-fixing is safe.>
```

Keep tasks small and single-purpose so they can be enabled or disabled by
adding or removing one file.
